verdict.rationale: Penpot ships an official MCP server built on its plugin API for "multi-directional" AI workflows. The docs describe agents "generating editable design structures" and migrating designs into Penpot through MCP, which are write operations. A documented plugin system and a token-authenticated backend RPC API with an auto-generated OpenAPI spec (152 paths) add further programmatic surfaces. Missing for 10: an explicit list of MCP write tools or plugin-API create/modify methods, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents editing designs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows through our world-class open plugin API.
Penpot enables plenty of AI workflows, from generating editable design structures to connecting product logic, tokens, and implementation.
Migrate your designs into Penpot by connecting Figma's and Penpot's MCPs.
AI agents can easily read and interact with your design files creating high-fidelity artifacts.
Penpot's hosted SaaS instance serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for the backend RPC API (152 paths, server design.penpot.app/api/main/methods).
